newsitem.title: USA: U.S. jet diffs end lower in post-Christmas torpor.
newsitem.headline: U.S. jet diffs end lower in post-Christmas torpor.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel differentials ended mixed Thursday, though market players said no deals appeared to get done due to the thin conditions.
"We need to get some more players to the table," one trader said, bemoaning the subdued post-Christmas action.
New York Harbor prompt 54-grade jet fuel was offered at 2.00 cents over the screen, a decline of about 0.50 cent from Tuesday.
U.S. Gulf 54-grade barrels for delivery on the 36th cycle of the Colonial Pipeline were offered at 5.00 cents under, while buyers backed off to 5.75 cents under the print.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1626
